behavior: When `Combobox.Popup`, `Dialog.Popup` or `Drawer.Popup` closes, the focus returns at the close, before the exit animation ends. During the exit, the focus is not in the closing popup, and no focusable content is under `aria-hidden`. The focus also returns to the trigger of an outer popup when a popup inside it, such as a nested dialog or a menu, closes in the same update or during the exit of the outer popup. Base UI returns the focus when the popup unmounts, after its exit animation.
